title: Stand Up Paddle Colorado - Lake Dillon
specs: Lake Dillon offers flat water and 360° mountain views
Experience highly recommended for outrigger canoe rentals; taking a lesson recommended unless proficient
Tandem kayaks fit 2 people; two six-man canoes fit up to 12 paddlers

options.name: Dillon Outrigger Canoe Club Membership
options.detail: Access to club paddles and discounted rentals

includes: Paddle and PFD included with outrigger canoe rentals
blurb: Guests rent stand up paddleboards, kayaks, tandem kayaks, and outrigger canoes to paddle on Lake Dillon. Rentals include safety and paddle talks for outrigger canoes. The Dillon Outrigger Canoe Club offers membership for access to club paddles and discounted rentals.
extraNote: $20 fee per person for sharing rented vessels · Reservations recommended at least one day in advance; walk-ins accepted first come first served · Be aware of changing weather and lake conditions · Dillon Marina, 150 Marina Drive · May 24th – September 7th
